title: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the departure of CFO Sandip Kapadia and the appointment of Glenn Reicin as his replacement, effective April 14, 2026. Reicin's employment terms include a $500,000 annual base salary, 50% target bonus, and a $3,000,000 stock option grant with standard vesting terms. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: CFO Sandip Kapadia resigned effective April 14, 2026 to pursue other career opportunities
Harmony Biosciences appointed Glenn Reicin (age 61) as new CFO effective the same date
Reicin's base salary is $500,000 with a 50% target annual bonus opportunity
Reicin received a stock option grant with aggregate fair value of $3,000,000
Option vests 25% after year one and 75% quarterly thereafter through year four
Separation agreement and employment agreement details are filed as exhibits
